source_name: SEI-NET — Electronic information system for listed issuers (Macedonian Stock Exchange)
why_relevant: Mandatory disclosure channel where MSE-listed banks (Komercijalna, Stopanska, UNI, TTK, Centralna kooperativna, Silk Road, Halkbank etc.) file price-sensitive announcements: audited/unaudited financials, capital measures, supervisory-driven decisions, shareholder assembly convocations. Where regulatory change becomes bank-specific and dated.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange (Македонска берза) — issuer pages + per-issuer SEI-NET RSS
why_relevant: Per-issuer hub linking each listed bank's SEI-NET announcements, prospectuses and financial data, with a machine-readable RSS feed per issuer — the cheapest reliable trigger for 'a bank just filed something'. Issuer slug pattern makes the whole bank universe enumerable.

source_name: Komercijalna Banka AD Skopje — news, client notices, fee/tariff and investor-relations pages
why_relevant: Largest MK bank and MSE issuer. Publishes dated customer notices on payment-service law changes, fee documents, and shareholder/financial reporting. Fee-tariff changes here (e.g. the 2025 repricing after the National Bank's tariff model) are the observable downstream of regulation.

source_name: Stopanska Banka AD Skopje — news, tariffs, data & reports
why_relevant: Systemic bank (NBG/OTP group). 'Податоци и извештаи' hosts annual reports and the Pillar-3-equivalent disclosure; tariff pages carry effective dates; payment-services-law page tracks PSD-aligned obligations.

source_name: NLB Banka AD Skopje — public announcements, shareholder page, fee/terms pages
why_relevant: Major systemic bank; publishes 'Соопштенија за јавност', shareholder disclosures, and dated product-rule changes (e.g. authentication changes for online payments effective 1.3.2026) that trace directly to payment-security regulation.

source_name: Sparkasse Bank Makedonija AD Skopje — announcements (Соопштенија) with dated terms/tariff amendments
why_relevant: Best-observed example in this cell of the exact artefact the cell targets: a single announcement bundling the statutory annual fee report availability plus amendments to the tariff and General Terms for individuals with an explicit effective date (31.03.2025); a further tariff change effective 1 June. Dated-URL structure (/mk/soopshtenija/YYYY/MM/DD/slug) makes it highly crawlable.

source_name: Halkbank AD Skopje — tariff and documents/forms pages
why_relevant: Systemically relevant Turkish-owned bank. Tariff and 'Документи и формулари' pages are where amended general terms and fee schedules surface; securities page relevant to custody/issuer duties.

source_name: TTK Banka AD Skopje — 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' (Pillar-3 style disclosure) and bank site
why_relevant: Confirmed publisher of the Macedonian Pillar-3 equivalent — a dated 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' covering capital adequacy and risk-management processes, published to a stable /cms/Upload/PDF/ path. Also issues corporate bonds, generating MSE/SEI-NET filings, and runs a personalised payment-services notification portal.

source_name: Silk Road Bank AD Skopje — Media/announcements section
why_relevant: Smaller MSE-listed bank; its Media section carries dated 'Известување' items (operational, pension-payment, corrective statements). Small banks are where supervisory pressure and capital measures show up earliest and most visibly.

source_name: UNIBanka AD Skopje (Универзална инвестициона банка) — annual reports and shareholder-assembly document tree
why_relevant: MSE issuer. Publishes annual reports, audited financials and a versioned Corporate Governance Code (v19, dated 31.01.2025) under a predictable 'Редовно собрание/NN Редовна седница' PDF tree — a rare case where governance-document versioning is externally visible and directly dateable to regulatory change.

source_name: Centralna kooperativna banka AD Skopje (ЦКБ) — corporate site document uploads
why_relevant: MSE-listed bank publishing assembly packs and 'Извештаи и податоци на Централна кооперативна банка' with balance-sheet-date framing under a /ControlPanel/Upload/ tree — the bank-level prudential disclosure for a mid-size player.

source_name: ProCredit Bank AD Skopje — Соопштенија (announcements) and terms of use
why_relevant: Dedicated announcements page on a bank that positions itself as the digitalisation front-runner; changes to digital-channel terms and fee conditions here are early indicators of how payment/security regulation lands operationally.

source_name: Pari.com.mk — business/finance outlet covering bank tariff and disclosure changes
why_relevant: Covered both Sparkasse's June tariff change and the SEI-NET app relaunch; useful cross-check and early-warning layer for bank-level regulatory notices.

source_name: SEINet mobile application (iOS / Android) — push alerts on listed-issuer disclosures
why_relevant: Official MSE app allowing per-company subscription with immediate notification on publication. Establishes that a near-real-time push channel exists for bank filings; relevant for latency-sensitive monitoring design even if collection stays web-based.

source_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia (НБРСМ) — regulation repository (upstream reference for bank notices)
why_relevant: Not this cell's primary target, but the indispensable join key: each bank customer notice or terms amendment traces to an NBRSM Одлука/Упатство. Needed to attribute a bank's effective date to a specific rule, and to enumerate the licensed-bank universe.

source_name: MBA — Членови (member directory of banks, savings houses, financial institutions)
why_relevant: Fetched and confirmed: enumerates the full ecosystem — 13 banks (Komercijalna, Stopanska, NLB, Halk, ProCredit, Sparkasse, UNIBanka, Razvojna, Alta, CKB, TTK, Kapital, Silk Road), 2 savings houses (Можности, ФУЛМ) and financial infrastructure members Клириншка куќа (KIBS) and Македонско кредитно биро. A ready-made actor map for downstream cells.

source_name: MBA — SKIBOR reference banks / interbank rate framework
why_relevant: Association-administered benchmark (SKIBOR) — rules, panel-bank list and methodology are self-regulatory instruments that interact with benchmark-regulation alignment and NBRSM oversight; changes to the panel signal market structure shifts.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — Здружение на финансиски организации
why_relevant: Fetched and confirmed: the Economic Chamber's Association of Financial Organisations claims to unite all 12 commercial banks, both savings houses, pension companies, insurers, leasing and non-bank lending companies. It is the venue where cross-sector industry comments on draft financial laws are consolidated before submission to the Ministry of Finance/NBRSM.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Групација на небанкарски финансиски друштва
why_relevant: Grouping of non-bank financial companies (formed 9 Oct 2019, ~22 of 26 entities). Explicit stated priority is a fintech-industry development strategy with supervisors and legislators — i.e. lobbying on draft rules covering non-bank credit and fintech.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — Прописи / regulatory-info section
why_relevant: The chamber's 'прописи' stream summarises draft and adopted legislation and records member reactions — search results surfaced items on defining payment institutions, e-money institutions and cross-border payment transactions, and on members of the banking association submitting written amendment proposals to the Ministry of Finance. High-signal for which draft provisions are contested.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Вести (news feed)
why_relevant: Chamber news reports round tables (e.g. Ministry of Economy round table on consumer rights and fair financial services attended by banking association representatives) — reveals consultation events, participants and timing that are not announced elsewhere.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Здружение на трговијата (Trade Association)
why_relevant: Represents wholesale/retail traders — the merchant side of payments. Relevant to fiscalisation rules, cash-registration law, card-acceptance/interchange and consumer-protection drafts; merchants are the counter-lobby to banks on payment cost rules.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Асоцијација на осигурително-брокерски друштва
why_relevant: 35 insurance brokerage firms; adjacent-sector association whose positions on distribution/consumer-protection rules often travel with bancassurance and financial-services consultations.

source_name: Асоцијација на финансиски друштва (AFD / AFSANM)
why_relevant: Association of non-bank financial (fintech/alternative lending) companies, constituted 27 June 2019. Explicitly aims to build a fintech-industry strategy jointly with supervisory bodies and legislators and to set industry standards — the main organised non-bank voice in consultations. Has an English 'за нас' page.

source_name: MASIT legacy publications archive (oldmasit)
why_relevant: Legacy archive of MASIT publications/position documents; older policy papers frequently disappear from the current site, so this is the archival tail for ICT-sector positions.
